content.text: Checks clean: lint, typecheck, 127 tests, production build. Source behavior is structurally sound, but visual/brand readiness is not. Biggest misses: code places mark left, not top-right; motion uses 350ms built-in easing; live domain still serves older header.

Verdict: concept right. Implementation not fully done.

Anthropic direction matches: full identity → short AI identity. [Anthropic homepage](https://www.anthropic.com/) leads with `AI`.

Current behavior:

- `dhruv2mars` → `d2m` after `scrollY > 40`.
- Expands only below `12`. Good hysteresis. No flicker.
- `useScroll` + CSS transitions. Structurally sound.
- Lint, typecheck, build, 127 tests all pass.

| Before | After | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Logo link appears before `flex-1` in [site-header.tsx](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/components/site-header.tsx:18) | Move mark into right-side header cluster | Current code renders mark left. User asked top-right. |
| `aria-label="Home"` | `aria-label="Dhruv2mars — Home"` | All visible letters are `aria-hidden`; screen readers hear only generic “Home”. |
| `duration-350 ease-out` in [site-header-mark.tsx](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/components/site-header-mark.tsx:28) | `duration-200 ease-[var(--ease-out-quint)]` | 350ms feels slow. Built-in easing lacks Emil-style punch. Custom curve already exists in [globals.css](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/app/globals.css:160). |
| Animate `grid-template-columns` | Layer full/short marks; animate `opacity` + `transform` | Grid-track animation triggers layout every frame. Emil rule: prefer transform/opacity. |
| `motion-reduce:transition-none` | Remove movement, retain gentle opacity transition | Reduced motion should reduce movement, not make state changes feel abrupt. |
| Geist text spans | Shared canonical logo component/asset | Header mark can diverge from favicon/share-card mark. Current comment claims shared identity, but implementations differ. |
| No scroll-state tests | Test thresholds `0`, `12`, `40`, fast reversal, reduced motion | Current test suite cannot catch animation regressions. |

One more hard status issue: public [dhruv2mars.com](https://dhruv2mars.com/) still serves older `header-pill` markup. This `SiteHeaderMark` implementation is not live yet.

Recommended finish order: fix placement, fix accessible name, tighten motion, choose shared mark source, then verify top/down scroll on desktop + mobile + reduced motion and deploy.
whatever is wrong/inconsistent/inaccurate/incorrect, fix it within this branch only. and test and verify that everything is working as it should, take use of emil skills.

Using Emil design-engineering rules now. Done = mark placement, semantics, motion, reduced-motion, brand consistency, and live behavior all pass source checks plus browser-style verification on this branch. I’ll touch only logo/header files and leave unrelated worktree changes intact.
